# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load the simulated coastal forest carbon inventory
coastal_forest <- read_csv(here("data", "theme1_coastal_forest.csv"))
head(coastal_forest)
```

# Tasks

1. **Filter**: Keep only trees belonging to species `"Rhizophora mucronata"` with a DBH (Diameter at Breast Height) greater than 20 cm.
2. **Select**: Keep only the columns `plot_id`, `tree_species`, and `dbh_cm`.
3. **Mutate**: Calculate a new column `basal_area_m2` as:
   $$\text{Basal Area} = \pi \times \left(\frac{\text{DBH}}{200}\right)^2$$

Write your data wrangling pipeline in the block below:

```{r}
cleaned_forest <- coastal_forest %>% 
  filter(tree_species == "Rhizophora mucronata", dbh_cm > 20) %>% 
  select(plot_id, tree_species, dbh_cm) %>% 
  mutate(basal_area_m2 = pi * (dbh_cm / 200)^2)

print(cleaned_forest)
```
